tool_input.command: test -f .env && env_names='LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY LANGFUSE_BASE_URL LANGFUSE_HOST OPENAI_API_KEY ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'; for name in $env_names; do if [ -n "${(P)name}" ]; then print "$name=shell"; elif command grep -q "^${name}=" .env 2>/dev/null; then print "$name=dotenv"; else print "$name=missing"; fi; done
